Nuowen Kan (阚诺文)

About me

Postdoctoral Researcher

Media, Information, and Network group, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU).

Previouly: I received the B.S. degree in Information Engineering from Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, China, in 2017, the M.S. degree in Electronics and Communications Engineering from SJTU, in 2020, and the Ph.D. degree in Computer Science from SJTU, in 2024.

My current research focuses include:

  • AI for multimedia communication and network optimization
  • LLM Infra (collective communication/compute-communication overlapping/inference serving)
  • Deep reinforcement learning and VLA
